# Content progression

51 lessons, 207 key concepts, four parts. Each part ends with one course exam.

Each row: what the lesson introduces, which earlier lessons it depends on, and which exam items it prepares for. "Gap fill" marks a lesson that no exam item tests directly; see gap-analysis.md.

## Assumed knowledge

- Working with ratios and proportions
- Rearranging a one-line equation for any of its terms
- Reading, writing and calculating with numbers in scientific notation
- Reading values and slopes from a graph, and recognising a straight line
- Using sine and inverse sine on a calculator set to degrees

Natural logarithms are not assumed; lesson 4.5 introduces them.
